verdict.rationale: AgentMail is developer email infrastructure (APIs, inboxes, webhooks, MCP tools) for AI agents to send/receive mail — it is plumbing, not an AI assistant that learns a user's voice/tone and drafts reviewable replies. That drafting behavior would be built by a developer on top of AgentMail, not shipped by AgentMail itself, so this axis is a category mismatch for this product.
